positive_cases.name: legacy_attribute_read
positive_cases.scenario: Legacy managed password attribute read on a computer object.
positive_cases.rationale: Object access and password attribute selections both match.

positive_cases.name: current_attribute_read
positive_cases.scenario: Current managed password attribute read on a computer object.
positive_cases.rationale: Object access and password attribute selections both match.

negative_cases.name: computer_description_read
negative_cases.scenario: Computer object description read during inventory.
negative_cases.rationale: The password attribute selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: password_attribute_written
negative_cases.scenario: Managed password attribute written by the endpoint during rotation.
negative_cases.rationale: The event identifier selection covers reads, not directory changes.

negative_cases.name: group_object_read
negative_cases.scenario: Group object read during an access review.
negative_cases.rationale: The password attribute selection does not match.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
